name: Shinohara Yukinori
source:
Shinohara Yukinori is a Special Class Ghoul Investigator and an Investigation Commander in Division I. He was assigned to the 20th ward and responsible for the investigation of the Binge Eater.

In the past, he acted as Koutarou Amon's instructor at the CCG Academy. His last partner was Juuzou Suzuya. Shinohara was Kureo Mado's first partner. 

[From [url=http://tokyoghoul.wikia.com/wiki/Yukinori_Shinohara]Tokyo Ghoul Wikia[/url]]
